label: 暗黑维多利亚哥特烛光人像：低调暗光 + 冷暖混合光，85mm 超浅景深特写

subject.description: a clearly adult young East Asian woman, about 22-25 years old, with a delicate softly oval face — smooth contours, a slender but not sharp jawline, slightly soft cheeks — and cool-toned fair skin with real skin texture, clean and translucent but never plastic-smooth
subject.pose: standing in an almost completely dark room, holding a burning thick ivory-white candle in a vintage brass holder, facing the camera directly
subject.expression: large clear almond eyes with dark brown irises and distinct pupil highlights, looking straight into the camera — quiet, cold, slightly mysterious; straight natural brows, a slender straight nose with a small tip, softly closed naturally full dusty-rose nude-pink lips, a restrained expression without a smile
subject.wardrobe: a black-and-white Victorian Gothic long-sleeved dress — matte black sleeves extending over the wrists and part of the hands forming long slender black arm lines, an ivory-white high-necked blouse front with fine vertical pleats, a small ruffled stand collar and several pearl buttons in a clear geometric division against the black, a delicate pearl necklace with a black-gold Gothic cross pendant set with tiny jewels, antique-jewelry texture — Victorian Gothic, dark romantic, gothic-nun-inspired, vintage European portrait styling, but not an actual religious ceremony scene

sections.heading: Eye makeup
sections.body: emphasized — long curled lashes with individually defined upper and lower lashes, thin black inner eyeliner slightly extended at the outer corners, a faint pink-brown wash on the lower lids, subtle highlights at the aegyo-sal, a touch of pearl shimmer at the corners; a refined gothic-girl makeup look that keeps real photographic texture; cheeks carry a very faint cool-pink blush.

sections.heading: Hair
sections.body: long deep black-brown hair with a center part, naturally drawn back at the sides into a soft voluminous low curled structure at the back; abundant natural baby hairs at the forehead, a few long strands falling over the center of the forehead, some passing lightly near the brows and eyes; natural wispy sideburns; real individual strands, never a wig-cap look; an ivory-white vintage lace veil covers the crown and back of the head with extremely fine openwork lace edging, mixing vintage Victorian maid and nun-veil qualities, the white lace in strong black-and-white contrast against the dark background.

sections.heading: Hands
sections.body: the left hand at the lower left of the frame holds the vintage brass candlestick; the candle has already burned for a while, its top edge irregular with visible real melted wax and slight drips; the orange-yellow flame burns steadily with a bright white-yellow core, an orange-gold outer flame, and a very slight warm halo; the other hand rises near the right cheek without covering the face, five slender fingers naturally slightly curved, fingertips gently approaching the cheek.

sections.heading: Nails
sections.body: long almond/stiletto-shaped nails with a translucent nude-pink gradient, some nails carrying silver rhinestones, pearls, clear crystals, and dimensional bow or jewel ornaments — very refined, with real transparent resin and diamond reflections, never exaggerated.

camera.position: at extremely close range, a near-symmetric frontal composition broken only by the candle at left and the raised hand at right
camera.framing: the subject's face at the exact visual center with the eyes as the primary focal point in precise focus, the lace veil near the top edge, framed from the top of the head down to the chest

foreground.elements: A large candle and its flame entering from the lower left
foreground.coverage: the lower-left foreground, slightly defocused while the flame stays clearly readable

light.key: Low-key lighting: the real candle at lower left acts as the warm practical source, casting very soft orange-gold candlelight on the left cheek, jawline, nose wing, and hand, with only a very slight warm glow around the flame and no large overexposed areas
light.fill: a very soft, restrained cool-white frontal fill keeps the eyes, lashes, nose bridge, and lips clear — beautiful small catchlights in the eyes, a delicate highlight along the nose bridge, a moist reflection on the lips, soft layered skin tones — a cinematic warm-cool mixed lighting

background: a completely dark indoor environment, a near-pure-black background with no visible furniture, modern objects, or complex decoration; the black dress melts into the darkness, separated only by rim light and candlelight
palette_text: black, ivory white, pearl white, cool gray, warm gold
atmosphere: a midnight, quiet, mysterious, dark-romantic, vintage oil-painting atmosphere
